raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Clevertronic ist der Rundum-Partner fürs Smartphone-Leben: Wir kaufen gebrauchte Smartphones, Tablets und weitere Elektronik an, bereiten sie professionell auf und geben ihnen als geprüfte Refurbished-Produkte ein zweites Leben.

Mit rund 100 Kolleg:innen, mehr als 50 Mio. Euro Umsatz und profitablem Wachstum ohne Investoren gehören wir zu den größten Refurbishing-Unternehmen Deutschlands. Jetzt entwickeln wir Clevertronic zu einer Plattform rund ums Smartphone-Leben weiter - mit neuen Produkten, Geschäftsmodellen und Märkten.

Dafür suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit Erfahrungen im E-Commerce, die eigene Ideen einbringen, Verantwortung übernehmen und sich gemeinsam mit uns im Produktmanagement weiterentwickeln möchte.

Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst unsere E-Commerce-Produkte, den Onlineshop und die Customer Journey anhand von Kennzahlen und Kundenfeedback.
  • Du entwickelst daraus konkrete Verbesserungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung von der ersten Idee bis zum Go-live.
  • Du übernimmst von Beginn an Verantwortung für klar abgegrenzte Projekte, koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und behältst Fortschritt und Ergebnisse im Blick.
  • Du packst auch im Tagesgeschäft mit an und lernst dadurch unsere Produkte, Prozesse und Kundenbedürfnisse von Grund auf kennen.
  • Du nutzt KI für Recherchen, Analysen und die Vorbereitung deiner Projekte und probierst neue Einsatzmöglichkeiten aus.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrungen im E-Commerce, Produkt- oder Projektmanagement gesammelt.
  • Idealerweise hast du eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit wirtschaftlichem oder digitalem Schwerpunkt abgeschlossen.
  • Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen und kannst aus Informationen nachvollziehbare Schlüsse ziehen.
  • Du zeigst Eigeninitiative, arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig und möchtest Verantwortung für deine Themen übernehmen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Menschen zusammen und kannst verschiedene Perspektiven zusammenbringen.
  • Du gehst offen und neugierig mit KI und anderen digitalen Werkzeugen um und möchtest sie sinnvoll in deinen Arbeitsalltag integrieren.

Benefits

  • Echte Gestaltungsfreiheit und kurze Wege: deine Entscheidungen sehen wir direkt am Ergebnis.
  • Einen klaren Entwicklungspfad: bei uns wächst du mit deinen Fähigkeiten, übernimmst zunehmend Verantwortung und kannst deinen fachlichen Impact kontinuierlich vergrößern.
  • Ein Umfeld, das KI nicht ausbremst, sondern fördert: bei uns ist KI-gestütztes Arbeiten der Standard, nicht die Ausnahme.

Für einen guten Arbeitsalltag ist ebenfalls gesorgt: flexible Arbeitszeiten, ein modernes Büro direkt am Friedenspark in Münster, subventioniertes Lunch, Snack-Kiosk, Kaffee und frisches Obst, Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unsere Produkte und Corporate Benefits.

Klingt nach dem richtigen nächsten Schritt für dich?

Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf - ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Erzähl uns lieber kurz, warum du bei uns ins Produktmanagement einsteigen möchtest.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Junior HR Manager – Recruiting & People Operations (m/w/d)
description: Gestalte die HR-Zukunft einer neu gegründeten Hochschul-IT-Organisation in NRW Standort: Düsseldorf | Vertrag: befristet | Arbeitszeit: 25-40 Stunden HITS.NRW ist ein neu gegründeter, zentraler IT-Dienstleister für die öffentlichen Hochschulen in Nordrhein-Westfalen. Unsere Mission: Gemeinsam mit den Hochschulen für angewandte Wissenschaften sowie den staatlichen Kunst- und Musikhochschulen die Hochschul-IT der Zukunft gestalten. Dafür entwickeln wir landesweit skalierbare Services aus den Bereichen Cloud, Cyber Security, Software und IT-Procurement. Damit unsere Organisation weiter wachsen kann, suchen wir Dich: Du gestaltest unser Recruiting vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding und unterstützt zugleich im operativen People Management. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit der Geschäftsführung, unserer internen HR-Ansprechpartnerin und den Fachbereichen zusammen - mit viel Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Was dich erwartet Recruiting & Talentgewinnung – Dein Schwerpunkt: Steuerung und Koordination der Recruiting-Prozesse von der Stellenausschreibung bis zur Einstellung. Entwicklung zielgruppengerechter Stellenanzeigen, Auswahl geeigneter Recruiting-Kanäle und aktive Ansprache passender Talente. Durchführung von Erstgesprächen und Interviews sowie enge Begleitung der Fachbereiche im Auswahlprozess. Weiterentwicklung der Candidate Experience, unserer Recruiting-Standards und des Employer Brandings. People Operations – Deine ergänzende Aufgabe: Begleitung von On- und Offboardings sowie Unterstützung bei administrativen HR-Themen rund um Personalunterlagen, Verträge und Bescheinigungen. Pflege der Personaldaten und Mitwirkung an der Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung schlanker HR-Prozesse mit Factorial. Freude daran, aktiv auf Menschen zuzugehen, passende Talente zu identifizieren, für HITS.nrw zu begeistern und sie professionell durch den gesamten Bewerbungsprozess zu begleiten. Eine klare, wertschätzende Kommunikation sowie ein gutes Gespür für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und Situationen. Eine strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Lust in einem wachsenden Umfeld Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Bei uns zählt Wirkung und verlässliche Rahmenbedingungen, die Dir Freiraum für gute Lösungen geben: Arbeite flexibel & gut ausgestattet: Mobiles Arbeiten, flexible Zeiten, Teilzeitoptionen – inkl. Laptop, Smartphone und Zuschuss zu Deinem Internetanschluss. Verdiene fair: Transparentes Gehalt, passend zu Deiner Qualifikation, Erfahrung und Rolle. Entwickle Dich weiter: Wir fördern Dich mit individuellenTrainings & Zertifizierungen. Sei mobil: Dein Deutschlandticket geht auf uns – für Job und Freizeit. Gestalte aktiv: Übernimm Verantwortung in einer Schlüsselrolle mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum. description: Architektur entsteht dort, wo die richtigen Projekte auf die richtigen Partner treffen. Seit über 35 Jahren entwickeln wir, PASD Architekten , Architektur, die Menschen glücklich macht. Als Bindeglied zwischen Rechnungsprüfung, Steuerbüro und Finanzcontrolling sorgen Sie strukturiert, zuverlässig und in einem eingespielten Team für eine reibungslose Verwaltung, damit alle Rechnungen und Belege korrekt verarbeitet werden. title: Trust & Safety Lead (Technical) (f/m/d)
description: Your mission nebenan.de connects real neighbours under their real names. That only works if people feel safe here. Your mission is to keep our users safe: with technical safeguards built into our platform and API, with product features that help neighbours protect themselves, and in close partnership with our Community Management team. You look at everything security first. You ask how someone could attack the trust of our users, and you prevent it before it happens. At the same time you think in products, not only in backend systems: a well-placed warning in the interface, a clear reporting flow, or a safer default setting often protects more people than another rule on the server. Concretely, you will: Build safety into the platform Design and implement technical safeguards in our API and backend: abuse detection, rate limiting, verification checks, and the signals that catch fake accounts and scams early. Ship user-facing safety features. Reporting flows, warnings on suspicious messages, blocking and privacy controls, safer defaults. Safety that users can see and use. Threat-model new features before they ship. Ask how a bad actor would abuse them, and design the friction and detection against it. Think security first Stay current on how attacks on social platforms evolve: account takeover, fake accounts, romance and marketplace scams, phishing and QR lures, spam rings, coordinated harassment. Lead the response when something is spreading or someone is at risk: decide, act, then close the route it came through. Decide what we build ourselves and what we buy. Where the market already solves a problem, such as content scanning, evaluate it, buy it and integrate it. Build where the problem is specific to nebenan. Work as one with Community Management Our moderation team handles cases day to day. You build the tooling and the standards they work with, so the highest-risk cases move first and similar cases get similar outcomes. Turn what moderation learns into product and platform improvements, and turn platform signals into better moderation decisions. Keep us compliant, with evidence Own the platform-side obligations under the Digital Services Act and GDPR: notice and action, statements of reasons, complaint mechanisms, transparency reporting. Keep the evidence audit-ready as you go. Legal owns the interpretation; you make the platform meet it. Measure safety honestly: how much harm actually reaches users, how fast we act, and how accurate our decisions are. raw.title: Trust & Safety Lead (Technical) (f/m/d)
raw.description:
Your mission

nebenan.de connects real neighbours under their real names. That only works if people feel safe here. Your mission is to keep our users safe: with technical safeguards built into our platform and API, with product features that help neighbours protect themselves, and in close partnership with our Community Management team.

You look at everything security first. You ask how someone could attack the trust of our users, and you prevent it before it happens. At the same time you think in products, not only in backend systems: a well-placed warning in the interface, a clear reporting flow, or a safer default setting often protects more people than another rule on the server.

Concretely, you will:

Build safety into the platform

  • Design and implement technical safeguards in our API and backend: abuse detection, rate limiting, verification checks, and the signals that catch fake accounts and scams early.
  • Ship user-facing safety features. Reporting flows, warnings on suspicious messages, blocking and privacy controls, safer defaults. Safety that users can see and use.
  • Threat-model new features before they ship. Ask how a bad actor would abuse them, and design the friction and detection against it.

Think security first

  • Stay current on how attacks on social platforms evolve: account takeover, fake accounts, romance and marketplace scams, phishing and QR lures, spam rings, coordinated harassment.
  • Lead the response when something is spreading or someone is at risk: decide, act, then close the route it came through.
  • Decide what we build ourselves and what we buy. Where the market already solves a problem, such as content scanning, evaluate it, buy it and integrate it. Build where the problem is specific to nebenan.

Work as one with Community Management

  • Our moderation team handles cases day to day. You build the tooling and the standards they work with, so the highest-risk cases move first and similar cases get similar outcomes.
  • Turn what moderation learns into product and platform improvements, and turn platform signals into better moderation decisions.

Keep us compliant, with evidence

  • Own the platform-side obligations under the Digital Services Act and GDPR: notice and action, statements of reasons, complaint mechanisms, transparency reporting. Keep the evidence audit-ready as you go. Legal owns the interpretation; you make the platform meet it.
  • Measure safety honestly: how much harm actually reaches users, how fast we act, and how accurate our decisions are.

Your profile

  • Several years of experience building and operating production web platforms, ideally with a focus on trust & safety, anti-abuse, fraud prevention or application security
  • Solid Ruby on Rails experience in production, or clear evidence you pick up a new language and its ecosystem fast and well
  • Strong SQL and a real understanding of how databases behave; you can find an abuse pattern in the data yourself
  • A firm grasp of client–server architecture: what the client can and can't be trusted with, where the risk actually lives, and how an API fails under attack
  • Infrastructure fluency: AWS, logging, observability, queues. You can reason about a system under attack, not only under load.
  • A security-first mindset: you threat-model by instinct, probe how features can be abused, and stay current on attack vectors against social networks
  • A user- and product-centric view: you care how safety feels in the interface, and you are comfortable shipping or shaping frontend features (we use React and TypeScript) that help users stay safe
  • Works well with non-engineers: moderators, product, legal. You can explain a technical risk in plain language and take a moderation insight back into code.
  • Judgment under pressure: you keep users' safety and freedom in balance, and you decide quickly when someone may be at risk
  • Uses AI deliberately as leverage: directs and reviews generated code to production quality
  • Excellent English skills for working in our international team
  • A plus: German language and German-market moderation context
  • A plus: hands-on experience of a fraud, scam or impersonation wave at scale
  • A plus: experience selecting and integrating vendor tooling in a safety or security stack
  • A plus: a security background in threat modelling, incident response or offensive security

What we offer

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days
  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community
  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other
  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation

title: Projekt Controller (m/w/d) – Business Partnering & Performance
description: Über uns Wir sind ju:niz Energy – seit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt Pionierin für netzdienliche Batteriegroßspeicher. Von der Projektentwicklung über Bau und Vermarktung bis zum langfristigen Betrieb verbinden wir alle entscheidenden Kompetenzen unter einem Dach. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden BESS-Plattformen Deutschlands aufzubauen und die Energiewende mit leistungsstarker Speicherinfrastruktur messbar voranzubringen. Unsere BESS-Projekte durchlaufen viele Phasen – von Development und Investitionsentscheidung über Beschaffung und Bau bis zur Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe in den Betrieb. Als Projekt Controller bist du die finanzielle End-to-End-Schnittstelle zwischen Finance und Projektorganisation. Du übersetzt Verträge, Terminpläne und operative Entwicklungen in belastbare Budgets, Cashflows und Forecasts und schaffst so die Transparenz, die Projektleitung, CFO und Management für schnelle Entscheidungen brauchen. Deine Aufgaben Du bist zentraler finanzieller Ansprechpartner für unsere Projekte und die verbindende Schnittstelle zwischen Finance und Projektumsetzung. Die projektbezogene Budget-, Kosten- und Liquiditätsplanung verantwortest du und aktualisierst sie entlang des gesamten Projektverlaufs. Projektverträge und Terminpläne durchdringst du im Detail und überführst Zahlungs- und Leistungsmeilensteine in belastbare Cashflow- und Forecast-Planungen. Auf Projektebene überwachst du Projektkosten, Capex, Cashflow und Forecasts. Mit geeigneten POC- und Cost-to-Complete-Logiken stellst du die wirtschaftliche Transparenz über den gesamten Lebenszyklus sicher. Soll-Ist-Vergleiche und Abweichungsanalysen bereitest du entscheidungsorientiert auf und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für Projektleitung und Management ab. Die Projektteams unterstützt du bei Business Cases, Investitionsentscheidungen, Nachträgen und weiteren wirtschaftlichen Bewertungen. Eine konsistente End-to-End-Projektsteuerung sicherst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Development, Delivery, Procurement, Commercial und Finance. Für Projektgates, FID, Finanzierungsprozesse und Handover erstellst du finanzielle Entscheidungsunterlagen und begleitest die relevanten Abstimmungen. Projektcontrolling-Standards, Reports und Prozesse entwickelst du weiter und verbesserst damit Transparenz, Steuerbarkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit. Dein Profil Du hast ein Studium in Finance, Controlling, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich abgeschlossen. Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Projektcontrolling bringst du aus einem projektgetriebenen, kapitalintensiven Umfeld mit; Energie, Infrastruktur, Anlagenbau oder Bauwesen sind besonders relevant. Du kennst die kaufmännische Steuerung komplexer Projekte entlang des End-to-End-Lebenszyklus – von Development und Investitionsentscheidung über Umsetzung und Inbetriebnahme bis zum Handover. Verträge, Terminpläne, Zahlungsmeilensteine und Nachträge kannst du wirtschaftlich einordnen und sicher in Budgets, POC- und Cost-to-Complete-Logiken, Cashflows und Forecasts übersetzen. Die Auswirkungen von Projektverläufen auf GuV, Bilanz, Liquidität und Business Case verstehst du und kannst Risiken sowie Abweichungen frühzeitig sichtbar machen. Excel beherrschst du auf Expertenniveau; mit ERP-, Projektsteuerungs- und Reporting-Systemen arbeitest du strukturiert und sicher. Du verbindest analytische Tiefe mit Ownership, klarer Kommunikation und einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität und trittst gegenüber Projektleitung und Management als verlässlicher Business Partner auf. Deutsch beherrschst du fließend und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift. Für die enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Projektteams bist du regelmäßig an unserem Standort in Aschheim bei München präsent. Warum wir? Eine zentrale End-to-End-Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Finance und Projektumsetzung. Direkter Einfluss auf Wirtschaftlichkeit, Liquidität und Umsetzung unserer BESS-Projekte. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleitung, CFO, Management und allen relevanten Fachbereichen. Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau professioneller Projektcontrolling-Standards und -Prozesse. Eine klare Entwicklungsperspektive in einer Finance-Organisation, die mit unserer BESS-Plattform wächst. Kontakt Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Entscheidend sind Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem jeder sein volles Potenzial entfalten kann. Qualifikation

Wir suchen keine perfekten Lebensläufe, sondern Menschen, die ihr Wissen einbringen, sorgfältig arbeiten und sich fachlich weiterentwickeln möchten. Ob du gerade dein Studium abgeschlossen hast oder bereits erste Erfahrungen aus der Kanzleipraxis mitbringst: Bei uns findest du ein Umfeld, in dem du weiter wachsen und Verantwortung übernehmen kannst.

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften (Bachelor oder Master), idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Wirtschaftsprüfung, Rechnungswesen oder Steuern

Deine Aufgaben Verantwortung entlang des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses für ca. 25 Vertriebspartner und damit für einen monatlichen Umsatz im siebenstelligen Bereich. Schnelle und eigenständige Lösung von operativen Edge Cases und Koordination mit relevanten internen Teams. Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Verkaufsprozesses – von der Lead-Übergabe bis zum erfolgreichen Verkaufsabschluss und der Montageterminierung. Monitoring relevanter KPIs und Prozesse , um frühzeitig Risiken und Handlungsbedarf zu erkennen. Unterstützung bei der Skalierung der Sales Organisation durch bessere Prozesse, klare Verantwortlichkeiten und zunehmende Automatisierung. Teamplayer – du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Teams und Stakeholdern zusammen und bringst Themen gemeinsam voran. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. title: People Partner - Engineering, Product, Design (EPD)
description: TL;DR: We're hiring a Human Resources Business Partner to partner with Engineering, Product & Design (EPD) at Lovable - our largest and fastest-growing organization. You'll act as a trusted advisor to the leadership team, and fly at many different altitudes every day. You’ll advise on org design, location strategy, talent planning, employee relations, manager effectiveness, and change management as we scale across Stockholm and London. This is an in-office role is based in Stockholm or London. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. The Role You'll be deeply embedded with Engineering, Product, and Design as a strategic partner and operator: someone leaders trust for candid coaching, clear judgment, and pragmatic execution. You will spot patterns before they become problems, bring structure without slowing the team down, and turn People programs into AI enabled operating rhythms that work for a technical org. What You'll Do Strategic People Partnership — build deep partnerships with EPD leaders and act as a trusted advisor on the people decisions that shape the business: team design, leadership effectiveness, talent density, retention, and change. AI-Native People Operations — rethink how work gets done in an AI-native company: experiment with AI-enabled workflows to increase velocity and craftsmanship (e.g., manager enablement, insight generation, communications, and operating rhythms), and help EPD leaders adopt them in a thoughtful, human-first way. Org Design & Headcount Planning — partner with Eng Leads, Finance, Recruiting, and People Ops to bring clarity and discipline to workforce planning, reporting lines, role definition, spans/layers, contractor strategy, and future org shape. Performance Reviews — Run EPD's quarterly Signal Review cycle end-to-end, including manager prep, calibration, monitor/at-risk categorization, level corrections, follow-through, and clean operating rhythms. Talent Insights & Retention — use qualitative signal and people data to identify hot spots, flight risks, manager gaps, and team-level patterns early; translate those insights into practical interventions. Employee Relations & Risk Management — own complex employee situations, performance improvement plans, investigations, resignations, probation issues, and terminations for EPD in partnership with Legal and People Ops. Manager & Leadership Coaching — coach technical leaders through hard conversations, promotion readiness, org changes, feedback, accountability, team health, and moments where clarity matters more than consensus. People Program Execution — help shape and roll out scalable People programs for EPD, including manager enablement, career pathing, leveling consistency, compensation cycles, engagement follow-up, and change management. What We're Looking For 10+ years as an HRBP or People Partner, with meaningful experience directly supporting Engineering, Product, Design, Research, or similarly technical organizations. Experience at an AI-native, developer tools, product-led, or high-growth technology company. Strong business judgment and the ability to connect people decisions to company priorities, product velocity, leadership effectiveness, and team performance. Excellent judgment in employee relations, including sensitive performance, conduct, probation, resignation, and termination situations. Comfortable giving hard feedback to senior technical leaders while maintaining strong relationships and discretion. Comfort with ambiguity, pace, and imperfect systems in a company where structure is still being built in real time. About your application Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p>At Anaplan, we are looking for a strong Senior Platform Engineer to join our team.&nbsp;</p> <p>Are you a creative problem solver who can both give and receive feedback? Do you lead with inclusion, collaboration, and openness? Do you have strong experience with high-scale B2B and B2C platforms?<br><br>As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll be crafting and helping build the next generation of the Anaplan&nbsp;Platform. You’re comfortable with both full-stack systems design for the hybrid cloud as well as hands-on&nbsp;distributed systems programming with extensive knowledge of Java, JVM, Rust, Linux internals and&nbsp;container orchestration.</p> <p><br><strong>The Role</strong><br>We're looking for experienced engineers who've built real products at scale and apply that&nbsp;same rigor to platform engineering. You'll engineer new platforms as products, not just operate&nbsp;existing infrastructure. You understand user experience, reliability, and technical debt from&nbsp;shipping production systems. You'll design platforms that are extensible, observable, and&nbsp;maintainable, enabling internal teams to build on top of them while handling the complexity&nbsp;underneath.<br><br><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p><strong>Kubernetes Engineering &amp; Automation</strong><br>You don't just write Helm charts or YAML manifests; you extend the Kubernetes API.</p> <ul> <li>Custom Operators: Proven ability to write Kubernetes Operators (using Kubebuilder or Operator SDK) to manage complex, stateful application lifecycles.</li> <li>Control Plane Logic: Deep understanding of reconciliation loops, custom resource&nbsp;definitions (CRDs), and how to automate operational knowledge into code</li> </ul> <p><strong>Scalable Microservices &amp; Distributed Systems</strong><br>You build for high concurrency, low latency, and eventual consistency.</p> <ul> <li>High-Scale SaaS: 10+ years of experience building and operating production-grade SaaS&nbsp;products. You should understand the&nbsp;performance characteristics, limitations, and cost-drivers of S3, NFS, and enterprise<br>storage like NetApp OnTap or AWS FSx.</li> <li>Data Locality: Experience managing data persistence across hybrid environments&nbsp;(Public Cloud vs. Private DC).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Maturity (The "SRE" DNA)</strong><br>You believe that "if it isn't monitored, it doesn't exist."</p> <ul> <li>Instrumentation: Expert-level experience with OpenTelemetry. You don't just look at&nbsp;metrics; you design the telemetry that allows for deep-dive distributed tracing and root-cause analysis.</li> <li>Observability Infrastructure: Hands-on experience scaling Prometheus and Grafana to<br>handle high-cardinality data.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Your Skills</strong><br>· BS degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience as a professional Platform Engineer.<br>· Substantial experience in Java, RUST programming experience<br>· Proven experience in building and operating a SaaS product at scale.<br>· Proven cloud experience using observability and operating workloads in Kubernetes.<br>· Experience with cloud storage S3, NFS, NetApp OnTap, AWS FSX<br>· Distributed Systems and programming techniques.<br>· Monitoring and metrics infrastructure (OTEL, Prometheus, Grafana).<br>· Cloud (AWS / GCP/ Azure / Private DC).<br>· Bonus: Experience with AI/ML, Natural Language</p> <p><strong>Technologies you’ll work with:</strong><br>· Programming languages: GoLang, Java11, Kotlin, Rust, Python<br>· Storage &amp; Persistence: S3, NFS<br>· Container and Orchestration: Kubernetes/Containers (Docker)/Rancher RKE<br>· Cloud providers: AWS, GCP, Azure, Private Data Centers<br>· Observability/Telemetry: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana<br>· Deployment: Jenkins, ArgoCD</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

 

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

 

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times , and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab. Functions of the Role As Director of Systems Delivery , you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments. We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory ; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements. Full-Stack System Execution : Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover. Cross-Functional Alignment : Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs. Site Infrastructure Readiness : Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment. Acceptance Testing & Governance : Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols. Service & Operational Handoff : Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime. Process Standardisation : Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. Supply Chain Management : Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines. Commercial Scoping Support : Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability. Experience - Essentials Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times. Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints. Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams. Track record of taking first-of-a-kind physical hardware platforms from prototype to repeatable deployment models. Hands-on experience managing facility readiness and running structured customer acceptance protocols. Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting. Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement. Strong communication skills with key stakeholders, including executive, technical, and customer audiences. Willingness and eligibility to travel internationally to customer sites as required. Experience - Desirable Direct technical background in quantum computing systems, cryogenic systems, silicon platforms, or HPC architectures. Experience establishing post-delivery field support, service handoffs, or customer support operations for complex hardware. Experience scaling system assembly and delivery operations within a deep-tech environment. Experience supporting hardware/software technical scoping for commercial proposals. raw.title: Engineering Manager
raw.description:
About Stora

Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.

Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated.

In just over five years, Stora has grown from an early-stage product into a platform used by more than 500 operators.

We’re a product-led, remote-first company with an experienced engineering team and ambitious plans for what comes next.

Now, as the engineering organisation grows, we’re hiring an Engineering Manager to make sure the way we lead, develop and support engineers grows with it.

The Role

This is a genuine people leadership role.

You’ll manage approximately 12 engineers working across three product teams, with the team expected to continue growing.

Each product team has a Tech Lead responsible for technical direction, alongside Product and Design. Your focus is different: the engineers themselves.

This isn’t a role for somebody looking to move away from engineering completely, though. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand the work, follow engineering discussions and ask good questions without needing to be the person making every technical decision.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Engineering and have support from People, but you’ll have meaningful autonomy to improve how engineering management works at Stora.

What Else You’ll Own

Engineering Management

  • Manage engineers across multiple product teams through regular, useful 1:1s, coaching and clear feedback.

  • Make expectations clear and help engineers understand what good performance looks like.

  • Identify performance issues early and handle difficult conversations properly when needed.

  • Support engineers in progressing from junior through senior and beyond.

  • Build strong relationships with engineers without creating unnecessary management overhead.

Performance & Progression

  • Own the engineering performance and progression approach.

  • Review and improve our existing career levels, expectations and review processes.

  • Make promotion and progression decisions that are consistent, evidence-based and understood by the team.

  • Create a culture where feedback happens throughout the year rather than being saved for formal reviews.

Hiring & Team Development

  • Own engineering hiring alongside the relevant Tech Leads and wider team.

  • Help define what we need before a search begins, assess candidates properly and maintain a high hiring bar.

  • Ensure new engineers have a structured and useful onboarding experience.

  • Think proactively about team composition, capability gaps and future hiring needs.

Team Health

  • Pay attention to engagement, retention, collaboration and emerging people issues across the engineering organisation.

  • Work with Tech Leads when team problems sit somewhere between technical delivery, behaviour and team dynamics.

  • Help maintain a strong remote engineering culture as Stora grows.

Technical Context

  • Stay close enough to the engineering work to understand what the team is solving and the environment they’re working within.

  • Be comfortable reading code, following pull requests and participating intelligently in technical conversations.

  • Partner with Tech Leads without competing with them for technical ownership.

What Success Looks Like

After your first year, we’d expect:

  • Engineers to have a clear understanding of what is expected of them and how they can progress.

  • Managers and engineers to be having better, more useful conversations about performance and development.

  • Performance issues to be addressed early rather than becoming surprises.

  • A progression framework that works for the engineering organisation Stora has become, not the company we were several years ago.

  • Stronger and more consistent hiring and onboarding.

  • The Head of Engineering spending less time acting as the default people manager for the entire engineering organisation.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager, rather than somebody taking their first step into management.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Previous experience directly managing software engineers across more than one team or product area.

  • A strong track record of developing engineers at different stages of their careers.

  • Hands-on experience managing performance, including difficult or underperformance situations.

  • Experience making promotion and progression decisions.

  • Experience running or improving engineering career frameworks, review cycles or progression processes.

  • Previous experience hiring software engineers and building effective interview processes.

  • An engineering background that allows you to understand code and contribute meaningfully to technical conversations.

  • The judgement to know when to get involved and when to leave technical decisions with the Tech Leads.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in a remote environment.

  • A practical understanding of how AI tools are changing software engineering and experience using them in your own work.

Experience with Ruby or Rails would be useful, but it isn’t essential.

We’re much more interested in whether you can lead engineers well.

What This Role Isn’t

It’s worth being clear that this isn’t:

  • a Tech Lead role with some people management added on;

  • a delivery or project management position;

  • a Product Manager role;

  • a hands-on engineering role where you’ll spend most of your week writing production code;

  • a first Engineering Manager opportunity.

Technical leadership already exists within the product teams.

We’re hiring you because engineering management itself deserves dedicated ownership.

Our Technology

You won’t be expected to spend most of your time writing production code, but you should be comfortable working around our stack.

Backend: Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, TimescaleDB

Frontend: Turbo, React, ViewComponents, Sass

Testing: Minitest, Playwright

Deployment: GitHub Actions, Heroku

Salary & Benefits

  • Salary: Highly competitive and depending on experience

  • Location: Fully remote within the UK or Ireland

  • Belfast office: Available for anyone who wants to use it

  • Private health insurance for you and your family

  • Company pension

  • 35 days’ annual leave inclusive of applicable public/statutory holidays, depending on location

  • Learning and development support

  • Share options

  • Work-from-home budget

Our Hiring Process

We’re reviewing applications as they arrive rather than waiting for a closing date.

If your experience looks like a strong match, we’ll explain the process clearly from the outset and move quickly.

Equal Opportunities at Stora

Stora is an equal opportunities employer.c

We want to build a workplace where people are treated fairly, with dignity and respect, and where different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are valued.

We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

Recruitment and employment decisions are based on merit, competence and business need, and we promote equality of opportunity and fair participation in line with our responsibilities under Northern Ireland equality legislation.

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

  • Support the broader CS team by providing pooled coverage as more creators move out of dedicated 1:1 management

  • Provide reactive support to creators in the pooled segment when risks, problems, or support needs arise

  • Partner with Product, Support, Moderation, and Growth to close feedback loops and improve creator outcomes

  • Track and report on cohort-level retention, contraction, and engagement metrics

This is a senior, client-facing role. You will regularly represent Neudata in front of senior stakeholders, handling detailed and unplanned questions as they arise, and producing polished, client-ready written analysis as a core part of the job. We’re looking for someone who can operate independently, exercise judgment, deal with ambiguity, and remain composed with demanding clients.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Own consulting engagements from kick-off through delivery, managing scope, timelines and quality, and acting as the day-to-day engagement lead for client communication and expectations

  • Structure project workstreams and personally produce the underlying analysis and written deliverables across data product strategy, pricing, go-to-market planning and buyer validation

  • Lead client meetings, working sessions and delivery readouts, fielding detailed questions from senior client stakeholders directly and translating complex data, market and technical input into clear, actionable recommendations

  • Plan and manage multiple concurrent engagements against agreed timelines and scope, proactively identifying and managing risks, dependencies and resourcing needs

  • Draw on the wider Research team for specialist input where useful, while owning the core deliverable and client-facing work end to end

  • Work closely with the Consulting practice on scoping, pricing input and follow-on opportunities, while reporting day to day within Research

  • Develop deep expertise in data monetisation, external data markets and buyer expectations, and contribute to internal frameworks, templates and client-facing insight

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven, relevant experience in consulting, strategy, alternative data, analytics or a related advisory role - we're open on level of experience, from a few years' track record through to seasoned practitioners

  • Demonstrated project management experience, ideally leading complete engagements rather than individual workstreams

  • A confident, polished, client-facing operator, comfortable presenting to and fielding scrutiny from senior stakeholders independently

  • Strong written skills and a track record of personally producing, not just reviewing, high-quality client deliverables

  • An independent working style, with a track record of owning outcomes and supporting the wider team

  • Knowledge of data products, data strategy or data monetisation concepts

Our Benefits & Perks:

  • 25 days’ annual leave, plus an extra day for each year of service (up to 30 days), alongside one paid volunteering day and two paid study days per year

  • Hybrid and flexible working, including working from anywhere for up to 10 working days per year from a location of your choosing

  • Private medical insurance via Vitality (including dental, optical, and hearing)

  • Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental policies

  • Enhanced pension scheme via NEST

Key Details:

  • Location: London (Moorgate) with hybrid working. Given the global scope of the role, quarterly travel to international teams is anticipated

  • Salary: Competitive base salary and incentive package

  • Start Date: ASAP

  • Line Manager: Founder & CEO

Recruitment Process:

  1. Initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  2. Competency interview with our Head of Research

  3. Meetings with key Neudata stakeholders

  4. Final stage presentation

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition Manager.

description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . What we're looking for We're looking for someone hungry to learn and early in their career to join us as our Revenue Operations Associate ! You'll get an inside look at, and be a key part of, how a high-performing GTM function operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth business moving. You'll sit at the intersection of our GTM, Customer and Finance teams, keeping our systems, data, and reporting sharp as we scale. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role – you'll inherit processes that are still being built, and you'll have real room to audit what's working, fix what isn't, and put your own stamp on how we operate. You'll get broad exposure early: one week you might be untangling a HubSpot workflow, the next you're building a dashboard the CCO takes into a board meeting. It's a genuinely excellent grounding in how a B2B SaaS business scales – but it comes with real pace, longer hours than a typical first job, and a learning curve to match. If you want breadth of exposure and a steep climb early in your career, this is a great seat. What Can You Expect? Keep our GTM tech stack in good shape: Own day-to-day CRM administration – data hygiene, permissions, and workflow upkeep – and support the configuration and integration of the wider stack. Stay ahead of what's new: Keep across releases and new features across our tools – joining release webinars, reading release notes, and flagging what's worth adopting. Help evaluate and set up new tools: Get involved as we add to the stack, from evaluation through to implementation. Improve our data quality: Spot where data is incomplete or inconsistent, fix what you can, and propose fixes for the rest. Build reporting and dashboards: Turn raw data into dashboards and reports that track pipeline health, funnel conversion, and the other KPIs the GTM team relies on day to day. Support incentive tracking: Help maintain and monitor commission and incentive tracking, making sure calculations are accurate. Onboard new GTM joiners: Train new starters across the GTM and Customer teams on our tools and processes so they're productive quickly. Own our recurring admin cadence: Take ownership of the regular tasks that keep the engine running and look to automate where ever possible. description: About Odin Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should be putting it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legals and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why We're Hiring We're hiring across product, design, engineering, growth, legal and operations - and our US launch will add New York hiring on top of that. Hiring the right people is central to our success to not have someone focused on it entirely. You'll find exceptional people, but you won't just be the person holding everyone to a bar - you'll work with the founders and leadership team to shape what that bar actually looks like. This isn't a role where you speak to candidates and move them through a process. You'll understand the product, business and teams deeply enough to assess people properly, challenge hiring managers when needed, and hold the business to the same standard we expect from candidates. And because you'll often be the first person someone meets from Odin, you'll need to give exceptional people a reason to care about a company many of them haven't heard of yet. Employer brand is a core part of the role, not something you get to once hiring goes quiet. You'll help build the content, events and community engine that puts Odin in front of the best operators in tech before they're looking for their next job - and makes hiring easier over time. Responsibilities Run hiring end to end across senior and business-critical roles, from role scoping through to start date. Own pipeline. The people we most want to hire often aren't applying, so outbound, market mapping, network building and getting others involved in referrals are a core part of the week. Run hiring kick-offs that create real clarity around what the role is, what great looks like, and how we're going to assess it. Design interview processes that test reasoning, behaviours and capability rather than rehearsed answers, using challenges, scorecards and structured assessments where appropriate. Own candidate communication end to end, with the same level of care whether someone is progressing or not. Keep employer brand top of mind and be hands-on in shaping it. Whether through content, events or community, you'll find ways to put Odin in front of the right people before they're looking for a job. Use AI as part of how you operate across sourcing, research, screening, candidate experience, operations and employer branding. Use hiring data to change decisions, prioritise roles and coach managers — not simply to report on the funnel. Continuously improve how we use Ashby, our hiring documentation and the quality of our interviews. Give clear, well-reasoned hiring recommendations with limited oversight, including when your view isn't what a hiring manager wants to hear. Who You Are An experienced recruiter with an unusually high bar for quality and strong judgement across functions. You notice patterns, inconsistencies and signals others can miss, and assess reasoning, behaviours, capability and values rather than relying on experience on paper. Brilliant at asking questions and getting underneath people's reasoning. You surface the questions others are thinking but haven't said out loud, interrogate incomplete briefs, and keep digging until there's real clarity. Comfortable bringing an original point of view rather than simply playing back what's already been said. You'll challenge founders and hiring managers when needed, and do it constructively. Deeply care about candidate experience, even when things are moving quickly, and hold the same bar whether someone is progressing or not. Operationally tight: you spot blockers early, keep processes moving and improve the system while using it. You've used AI in a meaningful way to improve how you hire and can give clear examples of what changed as a result. Bonus if you have Experience as a first or early Talent hire, where you've had to build structure from scratch. Experience building employer brand or talent marketing that materially changed who engaged with or applied to a company. Experience using hiring funnel or market data to influence decisions, prioritise roles or coach hiring managers. This role is probably not for you if... You need a lot of structure before you can make progress. There's plenty here still to build, and you'll need to be comfortable creating clarity rather than waiting for it. You avoid making decisions when the context is incomplete. We need someone who can gather the right information, form a view and make high-quality calls without escalating every grey area. You find it difficult to challenge senior stakeholders. You'll need to push back constructively, challenge assumptions and drive clarity with people across the business. You don't enjoy outbound. Proactive pipeline building is a significant part of this role; relying predominantly on inbound won't work here. You tend to take briefs at face value. We want someone who reads between the lines, asks what's missing and brings their own point of view rather than simply executing what they're given. Bottom line This isn't about whether you've done 360 hiring before - it's about how you approach it. We're not looking for someone to simply execute a hiring process. We're looking for a Talent partner who thinks deeply about the role hiring plays in the business, asks excellent questions, brings their own judgement and isn't afraid to challenge when needed. You'll often be the first person a candidate meets, and you'll have a meaningful influence on how our managers think about hiring. You're not just moving people through a process. You're helping us decide what great looks like, finding those people, shaping their experience of Odin and raising the quality of how we hire as we grow. Salary £70,000–£80,000 + equity options Working at Odin We're a London-based team, and this is a role where working closely with the founders and wider team in person makes a real difference. We move quickly, hiring priorities evolve, and many of the best conversations happen by being close to the teams you're hiring for. We therefore expect this person to be in our London office at least three days per week. title: Broker Development Manager
description: ABOUT FLOCK Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! THE ROLE Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission. WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE: Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel. A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING: Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success. Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets. Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential. Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors. Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance. Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business. Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives. Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission. Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin. WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK: ESSENTIAL A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry. Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives. An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm. Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes. Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs. Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business. PREFERABLE Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting. Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market. Can embrace new technologies and products, with experience of successfully distributing these to brokers. WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary) 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 Share Incentive Plan 📈 Workplace Pension 💰 Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options) Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵 Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣 £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓 £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻 At Flock, we typically follow a hybrid working model involving a minimum of 3 days per week spent in the office, which is based in Central London, a few minutes walk from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Please note if your role involves visit to client sites and broker offices, then this can be substituted for office days. ONE LAST THING.. Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want! Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
